author: GameTrailers
description: Black Voices in Gaming returns with an exciting global collection of upcoming indie titles, interviews and gameplay, and developer deep dives from Black creators.
title: Black Voices in Gaming 2026 Summer Game Fest Showcase

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Early Access Cinematic Trailer for Empulse, an upcoming first-person 6v6 arcade movement mech shooter developed by 1047 Games. Players will make use of wallrun, grapple, Holojump, and more to stay on the move in intense firefights. Pilot mechs and outmaneuver the opposition in Empulse, coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam), with Early Access sign-ups available now for PC.
title: Empulse - Official Early Access Cinematic Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Announcement Trailer for Kopernicus: Extraction, a top-down action roguelike shooter developed by Simon Lukasik. Players will embody the lone survivor of the SSC Kopernicus to face a cosmic nightmare and fight for long-forgotten memories. Expand the base, wield new weapons, and endure incremental suffering. Kopernicus: Extraction is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Kopernicus: Extraction - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the 'Wolves' Cutscene for The War of the Worlds: Siberia, a third-person action-adventure game inspired by H.G. Wells' science fiction novel, developed by MGLA. Players will witness Princess and the Student in the Siberian taiga defending themselves from an attack by a pack of wolves. However, as the scene progresses, they both realize that the greatest threat in this altercation is the different ideologies they both wield. The War of the Worlds: Siberia is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: The War of the Worlds: Siberia - Official 'Wolves' Cutscene Teaser (English Subs)

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch The Funskin Project for this upcoming survival horror game. The Funskin Project will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam. Now that a snowstorm has devastated the region, the only way to continue your journey is through the castle of the mysterious Baron Fetuccini. Arriving at the castle, you discover a nightmare from which it seems impossible to escape. Explore varied labyrinthine environments in a non-linear way, solve puzzles and riddles, and carefully manage your resources in this survival horror game where the slightest encounter can be fatal. Meet other characters who are also trapped in the castle. Assisting them may help you unlock the secrets behind the mysterious Funskin Project.
title: The Funskin Project - Official Demo Trailer | The Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at Livber: Smoke and Mirrors in this trailer for the upcoming short psychological horror interactive story. Five years after vanishing without a trace, the woman you once called your lover writes from beyond the silence: "I will give birth to our creation.” In three acts, descend into a fractured mindscape where obsession, memory, and myth intertwine. Livber: Smoke and Mirrors will be available on PC (Steam).
title: Livber: Smoke and Mirrors - Official Animated Trailer | The Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Release Window Trailer for House 2, a horror adventure game developed by Bark Bark Games. Players will embody a young girl who's braving a storm outside while trying to survive sinister forces inside her home. House 2 is launching in Summer 2026 for PC (Steam).

#ign #gaming
title: House 2 - Official Release Window Trailer | The Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Black Omens: House of Crimson Silk is a first-person, single-player, escape room puzzle horror game set in a fictional Edo Japan. Assume the role of Idate Chiyo, a paranormal investigator, tasked with investigating an abandoned mansion and unveiling a family's dark and horrifying secret. Check out the Black Omens: House of Crimson Silk trailer to see what to expect. Black Omens: House of Crimson Silk will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Black Omens: House of Crimson Silk - Official Trailer | The Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: When a grocery list becomes a struggle to survive against cosmic horrors, will you end up on the menu? Here's your look at the Last Chance Market trailer for this upcoming first-person, non-linear survival horror game. Make your offerings, complete your shopping and survive - or end up on a missing person poster. But you'd better hurry, the store's closing soon. Last Chance Market will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Last Chance Market - Official Announcement Trailer | The Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Release Date Trailer for Nowhere, a Nordic survival horror mystery game developed by Midnight Forge. Players will embody a detective trapped in the forests of Norway while searching for a group of missing tourists when you find there's more to the story than meets the eye. Nowhere is launching on September 30 for PC (Steam).
title: Nowhere - Official Release Date Trailer | The Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at Confined: Leaving OKB-134 in this trailer for the upcoming first-person horror/puzzle adventure game for PC and VR set in an abandoned soviet bunker. Seek safety by reactivating power, lights and machinery. Learn about long gone personnel, solve riddles and find a way to escape. But stay quiet! You’re not alone. Confined: Leaving OKB-134 will be available on PC and VR in 2026. A major demo update for Confined: Leaving OKB-134 is out now on Steam.
title: Confined: Leaving OKB-134 - Official Demo Update Trailer | The Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Paper Bleed is a creepy and grotesque point-and-click adventure, made with a raw art style and disturbingly gory hand-drawn animations. You find yourself in a horrible yet familiar place, facing your deepest fears and darkest thoughts. Nothing really dies here and you are all alone... Watch the Paper Bleed reveal trailer to see the unsettling world and art style. Paper Bleed will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Paper Bleed - Official Reveal Trailer | The Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at Pulsebreaker in this trailer for the upcoming survival horror game inspired by classic survival horror PS1-era titles. You step into the boots of Soren Eckhart, a lone survivor navigating a city consumed by a mysterious outbreak. Scavenge scarce supplies, solve environmental puzzles, and fight to survive against grotesque mutated foes while uncovering the truth behind why the city has become infected. Pulsebreaker will be available on PC via Steam, and a demo is out now.
title: Pulsebreaker - Official Demo Launch Trailer | The Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Murder Meet Cute, a point-and-click adventure horror mystery game developed by Kitico, LABORARE, and Crybaby Studios. Players will follow the life of Amy who fixes computers on the night shift. Serve clients with a smirk, mock dweebs on the conspiracy forum, and uncover a serial killer? All in a day's work in Murder Meet Cute, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Murder Meet Cute - Official Gameplay Trailer | The Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Join Chief Creative Officer Daniele Azara and Narrative Director Luca Esposito for a behind-the-scenes look at Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy in this developer diary for the upcoming third and last installment in the Remothered survival horror saga from developer Stormind Games. Azara and Esposito discuss the game's story, the new characters and the return of iconic ones. 

Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC in 2026.
title: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy - Official Dev Diary #2 | The Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Eldor'idle, a clicker-idle RPG game developed by Nautlander. Players will smash pots, recruit gnomes, raid mines, unlock upgrades, and optimize everything for financial gain. Eldor'idle is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Eldor'idle - Official Announcement Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for Kirk Mephisto, an action-adventure beat 'em up hack-and-slash game developed by Team Coreupt. Players will follow Kirk on his quest to stop the ongoing battle between birds and wormkind. Fighting alongside Kirk are his childhood friends Halice, the worm warrior princess, and Carper, the secret agent bee. Kirk Mephisto is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Kirk Mephisto - Official Reveal Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Reveal Trailer for Beyond the Dark Nightwatch, a co-op asymmetrical horror game developed by Atlantis Studios. Players will observe, lure, and coordinate their next steps to ensure survival together at all costs. Beyond the Dark Nightwatch is coming soon to Nintendo Switch 2.
title: Beyond the Dark Nightwatch - Official Reveal Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Demo Reveal Trailer for Canvas City, a turn-based tactics RPG developed by Disc 2 Games. Players will lead a crew of skaters and street artists rising up against an oppressive regime. Each map is a battleground and a canvas, where your actions shift control, leave your mark, and shape the city’s future. Canvas City is coming soon to Nintendo Switch and PC (Steam), with a demo coming soon.
title: Canvas City - Official Demo Reveal Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Demo Launch Trailer for Lucid, a Metroidvania action precision platformer developed by The Matte Black Studio. Players will platform through a crystalline world torn apart by calamity, absorb powerful abilities that expand movement and enhance combat against a diverse cast of enemies and bosses, all in gorgeous pixel art inspired by the golden age of 2D sidescrollers. Lucid is coming soon to PC in Summer 2026 with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Lucid - Official Demo Launch Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Cinematic Gameplay Trailer for Raji: Kaliyuga, an upcoming mythological third-person action-adventure game developed by Nodding Heads Games. Players can get a look Raji, the warrior of faith, and Darsh, the dreamwalker, face Mahabalasura’s wrath as he tears open heaven’s gates, unleashing Kaliyuga, an age where every choice can unmake the universe. Don't miss the cinematic look with action-packed gameplay of Raji: Kaliyuga, coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam, GoG, and Epic Games Store).
title: Raji: Kaliyuga - Official Cinematic Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Playtest Trailer for Erosion, an action roguelike developed by Plot Twist. Players will explore a roguelike open world where their actions reshape the timeline. Join a cult, steal a ride, gamble Cheddar. Collect 100+ weapons and abilities, demolish destructible voxel dungeons. Can you save your daughter before time steals her away? Erosion is coming soon to PC (Xbox on PC and Steam), with a playtest available now.
title: Erosion - Official Playtest Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Announcement Trailer for Bracer, a top-down action bullet hell game developed by Curious Fate and Akupara Games. Players will take on waves of enemies while weaving between incoming projectile attacks. Make use of a suite of weapons, acquire loot, and take on the chaos alone or with friends in co-op. Bracer is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Bracer - Official Announcement Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Gameplay Teaser Trailer for Kidbash: Super Legend, a 2.5D action platformer roguelike developed by Authentic Remixes and Fat Raccoon. Players will awaken in a world of forgotten game characters as a hero with no memory of his past. After failing to save a nearby village from destruction, can you rise, rebuild, and rediscover the true meaning of being a hero? Kidbash: Super Legend is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Kidbash: Super Legend - Official Gameplay Teaser Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Release Date Trailer for Signy & Mino: Against All Gods, an anime action-adventure tag-team battle RPG developed by AN Productions. Players will engage in action-packed battles where every move combos together! Discover your hidden powers as you find yourself hurtled into a conflict among the gods. Signy & Mino: Against All Gods is launching on July 30 for PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Signy & Mino: Against All Gods - Official Release Date Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Demo Gameplay Trailer for 13Z: The Zodiac Trials, a fast-paced, anime-inspired action roguelike developed by Mixed Realms. Players will master stylish hack and slash combat, craft overpowered builds, and conquer mythological trials to claim the title of the thirteenth Zodiac. 13Z: The Zodiac Trials is coming soon to PC (Steam) with a demo running from June 1 through June 25 on PC (Steam).
title: 13Z: The Zodiac Trials - Official Demo Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Gameplay Demo Launch Trailer for Duskfade, a 3D action-adventure platformer developed by Weird Beluga. Players shatter the shackles of time as you jump, swing, and slash through a fantastic world in this love letter to classic 3D action platformers. Zirian, accompanied by his mechanical Cuckoo, must save his sister from a mysterious Clock Tower that has plunged the land into eternal night. Duskfade is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Duskfade - Official Gameplay Demo Launch Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Early Access Release Date Trailer for Entropy, a tactical turn-based RPG developed by Lovely Hellplace. Players will assemble a party of mercenaries and forge your own path towards an expedition into hell to stop the demonic incursion. Choices you make along the way will determine the fate of your world. Entropy is launching into Early Access on August 18 for PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Entropy - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Wild Blue Skies gets a new trailer and a release date announcement. Watch the latest Wild Blue Skies trailer for this upcoming action-adventure game that reimagines the classic on-rail adventures of the '90s. Join Bowie Stray and the Blue Bombers as they soar through the skies on a mission to save the world in Wild Blue Skies. Wild Blue Skies will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam on August 13, 2026.
title: Wild Blue Skies - Official Release Date Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Reveal Trailer for Theos: Cities of Myth, a Greek mythos city management building game developed by Triskell Interactive. Players will devote their life's work to the great Greek gods in exchange for boons, special heroes, and renowned figures to join their thriving community. Tend to the citizens' needs, amass an army for defense, and let Mount Olympus remain pleased through city-building works and service. Theos: Cities of Myth is coming to PC (Steam) in 2026.
title: Theos: Cities of Myth - Official Reveal Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Chapter 7 Season 3 Release Date Trailer for Fortnite Runners, the latest season for the hit free-to-play battle royale shooter developed by Epic Games. Players will get a taste of the new skins, content, and more in store with the latest season coming to the game. Chapter 7 Season 3 for Fortnite is launching on June 6 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, iOS, Android, and PC (Epic Games Store, GeForce Now, Amazon Luna).
title: Fortnite Runners - Official Chapter 7 Season 3 Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss this behind the scenes look at the FlexStrike Wireless Arcade stick from PlayStation! Hear from the key voices that shaped the design of the stick, including the FGC's own Mark Julio, the current head of Global Buisness Dev for Evo. 
The PlayStation FlexStrike launches August 6th, along side Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls for PlayStation 5 and PC!
title: PlayStation - Official FlexStrike Fight Stick Design Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the reveal for the PlayStation branded 27" Gaming Monitor. Featuring up to 240hz refresh rates with VRR support, 1440p QHD display, HDR, in-build cable management, and even a charging hook for your DualSense or DualSense Edge! 

Pick it up from PlayStation Direct starting August 27th 2026 while stocks last!
title: PlayStation - Official 27" Gaming Monitor Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 Key Art BTS video. Showing how the teams at Infintiy Ward and Activison used real actors, locations, and effects to create the striking imagery for Modern Warfare 4's key-art. 
Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 launches on October 23rd 2026 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, PC (BattleNet, Steam, Xbox on PC) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - Official Key Art Behind The Scenes Video

author: GameTrailers
description:
Discover some of the best games coming out in 2026 and beyond!



Your hosts Phil Dickens, Ash Millman and Will Penkeyman are ready to take you on another dark, scare-filled journey through deep caves filled with new titles, exclusive trailers and thrilling gameplay reveals. 100+ games will be covered, with 50+ world premiere trailers in over two hours of upcoming horrors, so there’s plenty to keep you busy and set your wishlists overflowing!
title: MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: A Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the DLSS 4.5 & RTXDI Trailer for Honeycomb: The World Beyond, a base-building survival exploration sandbox game developed by Frozen Way. Players will explore an alien planet to crossbreed species, gather resources, and overcome challenges across Sota7. Take on the game with ray tracing, NVIDIA RTXDI, and DLSS 4.5 support powered by NVIDIA technology in Honeycomb: The World Beyond, coming in Summer 2026 for PC (Steam).

Source: https://youtube.com/nvidia
title: Honeycomb: The World Beyond - Official DLSS 4.5 & RTXDI Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the DLSS 4.5 Trailer for Cinder City, an upcoming third-person MMO tactical action shooter developed by BigFire Games and NCSoft. Players will take on an unknown future after the core timeline of humanity is altered by the arrival of 23rd-century humans traveling from the future. Take on enemies in unprecedented visual fidelity with DLSS 4.5 support courtesy of NVIDIA technology. Cinder City is coming soon to PC.

Source: https://youtube.com/nvidia
title: Cinder City - Official DLSS 4.5 Trailer
